source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Shrub or bushy small tree to ca. 5 m
morphology_documented.twigs: Sometimes reddish; naked reddish twigs conspicuous in winter
morphology_documented.leaves: Opposite, simple, entire, prominent arching lateral veins (genus); lower blade surface pale and densely spreading-pubescent, less often appressed-pubescent
morphology_documented.flowers: Small perfect terminal flowers, 4 calyx lobes and 4 petals (genus); petals 3.5–5.5 mm long; calyx lobes shorter than tube
morphology_documented.habitat: Stream banks, hillsides, woodlands and thickets
